## CORE RULE 2. No hate speech or discriminatory language.
This is a zero tolerance rule and is strictly enforced.
You are not allowed to spread hate speech, racism (including speciesism, which would be demeaning to other players based on their in-game race), sexism, bigotry, or use slurs (including variations of slurs, racial, sexual, disability related, or language closely tied to real-life slurs.)
